injury.comment: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.
Brown (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Antetokounmpo is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to right groin tendinitis.
Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Ball (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.
Embiid (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Fox (shin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.
Anunoby (calf) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Heat.
Harper (hip) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.
Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

note: Projections, not prices: no sportsbook lines are used. Built from L5/L10/L15/L20 averages, opponent defense by position, head to head, rest and injuries. Early in the season the windows reach back into last year's games.

backtest.basis: 99 players, 2025-26 games after each player's 8th, one game ahead, no lines
backtest.read: The half and half blend is a hair better than the season average and better than the windows alone. Opponent defense and home/away added nothing measurable, so defense is applied at a small weight and the home/away split is shown but not applied. A typical miss on points is about 6, so treat every number as a range, not a pick.
